LESSON: NON

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: BASIC
Topic 10.2: Non

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Non. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we turn and twist?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. turning and twisting for flexibility
2. turn and twist for safety Core-Competence Communication and Collaboration

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. turning and twisting for flexibility
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to turning and twisting for flexibility. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. turn and twist for safety Core-Competence Communication and Collaboration
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to turn and twist for safety Core-Competence Communication and Collaboration. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Non.
2. Explain Non to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Non.
4. Show that you can: turning and twisting for flexibility
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Non. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How do we turn and twist?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. turning and twisting for flexibility
2. turn and twist for safety Core-Competence Communication and Collaboration

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
